clinics.name: Braun Plastic Surgery (브라운성형외과)
clinics.namedDoctors: Ten surgeons are named on the English Our Surgeons page, each listed as 'Plastic Surgeon, MD' with Korean Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons membership: Dr. Kim Tae-Gyu (chief, MD PhD), Dr. Lee Ji-won, Dr. Ryu Dong-wan, Dr. Kim Young Ho, Dr. Jeon Hyeonjun, Dr. Kim Yoonhyun, Dr. Lee June Key Chris, Dr. Lim Beom Jin, Dr. Oh Sang Seong and Dr. Seo Du Heon. Two anesthesiologists are named: Dr. Kim Daewon (anesthesia and pain specialist, formerly Samsung Medical Center) and Dr. Kim Jin Seok. The Korean site states that an anesthesiology specialist is resident on site. The page does not use the phrase 'board-certified' for the surgeons; it lists society memberships.
clinics.credentials: On the Medical Korea registered list (checked October 30, 2026) as 'BRAUN PLASTIC SURGERY CLINIC' (registration M-2020-01-08-5956, 475 Gangnam-daero, Seocho-gu). Not on the KAHF accredited list or the Most Visited tab (checked October 30, 2026). Stated safety set-up on the Clinic Safety page: one-to-one anesthesiologist monitoring during surgery, directors trained in KALS CPR, defibrillators and emergency equipment, uninterruptible power supply, named-surgeon system with no surrogate surgery, CCTV recording available to patients on request. Site says 'since 2009'.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site. The site says estimated costs are given after a photo-based pre-consultation. FAQ notes card payments carry 10 percent VAT, of which up to 8 percent is refundable at the airport.

booking.channels: WhatsApp +82 10 2771 2401; phone +82 10 2771 2401; email consultation@braunps.co.kr; KakaoTalk open chat https://open.kakao.com/o/sPkGEsbd; LINE https://line.me/ti/p/5R9ZpXxyyW; WeChat and Viber by QR code only; online form https://www.braunps.com/online-consultation. Hours Mon-Fri 10:00-19:00, Sat 10:00-17:00 KST.
booking.consult: Free pre-consultation by photos over messaging apps or email, returning recommended procedures and an estimated cost. A video call with a doctor carries a small fee (amount not stated). Deposit terms not published. Payment by PayPal, bank transfer, card or cash; transfer fees are borne by the patient.
booking.languages: Country sites in English, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Russian, Mongolian, Japanese, Chinese and Malay; interpreters stated for recovery and follow-up.
booking.includes: Hotel recommendation and airport pickup mentioned for out-of-town patients; overnight nurse and translator stay after general anesthesia.

clinics.name: 365mc Seoul Liposuction Hospital (서울365mc병원)
clinics.namedDoctors: Eleven doctors are named for the Seoul hospital: Kim Hajin MD (chief medical officer), Lim Junyong MD (hospital director), Lee Seonghun MD, Lim Hyunjae MD, Choi Hyungyoon MD, Lee Suyun MD (board-certified general surgeon), Jung Wonju MD, Jeong Jinmook MD, Seo Sungig MD (the only one described as a plastic surgery specialist), Kim Kiusam MD (anesthesiology and pain medicine specialist, Seoul National University Hospital, '365mc Anesthesia Safety Team') and Lee Songyul MD (family medicine). Most surgeons are described as 'board-certified specialist' without the specialty being stated; one is a plastic surgery specialist. One full-time anesthesiologist is named. The site says each 365mc hospital has 'either an anesthesiologist or a dedicated safe anesthesia team', and that an anesthesiologist administers anesthesia directly for high-risk patients.
clinics.credentials: On the Medical Korea registered list (checked October 30, 2026) as 'Seoul 365MC Hospital' (M-2014-01-03-3299, 126 Seochojungang-ro, Seocho-gu, hospital type); several 365mc clinics and the Busan, Daegu, Incheon and Daejeon hospitals are registered separately. Not on the KAHF list (checked October 30, 2026). The site says it has been registered with the Ministry of Health and Welfare for attracting foreign patients since 2009 and carries medical malpractice liability insurance. Stated safety set-up: dedicated anesthesia team, infection control team, real-name surgeon system, 7-week 'Orange Care' aftercare.

booking.channels: WhatsApp chat and channel, KakaoTalk and LINE buttons on the Contact page (IDs and numbers shown only as buttons); international phone lines +82-10-2171-3657 and +82-10-5914-3653; email contact.global@365mc.com. Hours Mon-Fri 11:00-20:00, Wed 11:00-19:00, Sat 10:00-15:00 KST; closed Sundays.
booking.consult: Free online consultation via messaging apps; coordinators reply within 24 hours excluding weekends and Korean holidays. Photo or history requirements, fees and deposit terms not published.
booking.languages: English, Japanese, Chinese, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Malay and Azerbaijani stated.
booking.includes: Partner hotel reservation assistance; airport sending service only for Royal LAMS and Royal Liposuction package patients; recovery room; English medical certificates on request.

clinics.cautions: Structural note: 365mc is a network of more than 20 Korean branches plus overseas LAMS centers (Los Angeles, Jakarta, Surabaya, Bangkok), so the doctor roster and anesthesia set-up differ by branch; the profile above is for the Seoul hospital only. No regulator action, court case or press-reported incident naming 365mc was found in Korean press searches (October 2026).
